program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u043/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Find the two matching short colored runs on opposite horizontal borders.
    top = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != bg]
    bottom = [(c, grid[h-1][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[h-1][c] != bg]
    top_cols = [c for c, _ in top]
    bottom_cols = [c for c, _ in bottom]
    # Border runs are the task markers; their offset transports each interior marker.
    dt = min(bottom_cols) - min(top_cols)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(1, h-1) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        # Project the marker to the top border, and draw its translated full-height line.
        for rr in range(1, r):
            out[rr][c] = color
        out[r][c] = 4
        tc = c + dt
        for rr in range(h-1):
            out[rr][tc] = color
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-1c7ceba6.py'
path.write_text(source)
